title: Steel Industry Process Expert
desc:
About the Role
At Schneider Electric Türkiye, we aspire to become the trusted energy and technology partner for the steel industry, helping manufacturers accelerate their
sustainability, productivity, operational excellence, and digital transformation
journeys.
We are looking for a
Steel Industry Process Expert
who will combine deep knowledge of steel manufacturing processes with expertise in
process optimization, automation, digitalization, energy efficiency, and operational excellence
.
In this role, you will work closely with leading steel manufacturers to understand their production processes, operational challenges, and improvement priorities, identifying opportunities across
production optimization, energy efficiency, equipment reliability, quality improvement, automation, digitalization, and sustainability
.
Leveraging Schneider Electric’s comprehensive portfolio of software, automation, digital, and energy management solutions, you will translate process challenges into practical improvement opportunities and support customers in building transformation roadmaps that deliver measurable operational and business impact.
Job Description
Analyze customers’ steel manufacturing processes, operational challenges, performance gaps, and improvement priorities.
Act as a
process expert
across key steel production areas, including
melt shop, continuous casting, rolling mills, finishing operations, utilities, maintenance, quality, and energy management
.
Identify opportunities to improve
productivity, process efficiency, energy consumption, quality, equipment reliability, and operational performance
.
Translate production and process challenges into relevant Schneider Electric automation, digital, software, and energy management solutions.
Develop
steel-process-specific use cases
focused on process optimization, energy efficiency, quality improvement, predictive maintenance, reliability, and sustainability.
Support customers in assessing current process performance and defining improvement opportunities and transformation priorities.
Build business cases demonstrating measurable
operational, energy, sustainability, and financial value
.
Identify global best practices and innovative technologies relevant to steel manufacturing and adapt them to customer processes and local market needs.
Support customers in shaping their
process optimization, digital transformation, energy efficiency, and sustainability roadmaps
.
Collaborate closely with sales, consulting, automation, technical, services, software, and solution teams to design integrated solutions based on customer process requirements.
Provide process expertise during customer workshops, technical discussions, solution development, and strategic engagements.
Support business development activities by identifying process-driven opportunities within existing and potential steel industry customers.
Represent Schneider Electric as a
steel process expert
in customer meetings, workshops, technical events, and industry discussions.
Monitor developments in steel production technologies, automation, digitalization, decarbonization, and energy efficiency and assess their potential application to customer operations.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in
Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering
, or a related engineering field. Master’s degree is a plus.
8+ years of professional experience
, preferably within the
steel, metals, heavy industry, industrial automation, process engineering, or manufacturing sectors
.
Strong hands-on knowledge of steel manufacturing processes, ideally covering areas such as
melt shop, electric arc furnace (EAF), continuous casting, rolling mills, finishing lines, utilities, quality management, maintenance, and energy management
.
Solid understanding of
industrial process optimization, production efficiency, equipment performance, reliability, and operational excellence
.
Experience identifying process bottlenecks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities in industrial environments.
Good understanding of industrial
automation, control systems, digital technologies, software, and energy management solutions
and their application in steel manufacturing.
Experience contributing to or leading
process improvement, operational excellence, digital transformation, automation, or energy efficiency projects
.
Ability to translate complex production and process requirements into technology-driven solutions and measurable business value.
Experience developing or contributing to business cases related to
productivity, quality, energy efficiency, reliability, sustainability, and operational performance
.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a practical understanding of industrial operations.
Strong customer orientation with the ability to engage effectively with
plant management, production, process engineering, maintenance, automation, energy, and technical teams
.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary technical and commercial teams.
Fluent in
English and Turkish
.
Willingness to travel across Türkiye and occasionally internationally.
